method: Actual getContractorBySlug replay with connector results for its four SQL queries; actual parentSaveReadiness execution
detail_query:
SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(detail_row)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT id, slug, display_name, legal_name, dba_name,
           primary_city, primary_county, home_state, is_thin_profile
    FROM contractors
    WHERE slug = 'ccc057187-a-r-roofing-inc'
    LIMIT 1
    ) detail_row) AS profile,
(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(detail_row)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT id, external_key, occupation_code, license_number, status_normalized,
           primary_status, secondary_status, original_licensure_date, effective_date,
           expiration_date, address_line_1, city, state, postal_code, county_name,
           board_number, last_verified_at, source_system
    FROM licenses
    WHERE contractor_id = 'e3f84d9c-8d6d-4d4c-8bba-875e0c90807f'
    ORDER BY
      CASE status_normalized WHEN 'active' THEN 0 WHEN 'current' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
      external_key
    ) detail_row) AS licenses,
(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(detail_row)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT e.id, e.external_key, e.legal_name, e.status, e.entity_type,
           e.formation_date, e.principal_address, e.city, e.state, e.postal_code,
           e.registered_agent_name, e.officers, ce.match_method, ce.confidence,
           e.last_verified_at, e.source_system
    FROM contractor_entities ce
    JOIN entities e ON e.id = ce.entity_id
    WHERE ce.contractor_id = 'e3f84d9c-8d6d-4d4c-8bba-875e0c90807f'
      AND ce.role IN ('sunbiz_entity', 'linked', 'entity')
      AND e.source_system = 'fl_sunbiz'
      AND ce.confidence IS NOT NULL
      AND ce.confidence >= 0.9
    ORDER BY ce.confidence DESC NULLS LAST
    ) detail_row) AS entities,
(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(detail_row)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT id, complaint_number, license_type, classification, disposition,
           disposition_date, discipline_description, violation_code, entered_date,
           source_dataset, last_verified_at
    FROM discipline_actions d
    WHERE d.contractor_id = 'e3f84d9c-8d6d-4d4c-8bba-875e0c90807f'
      AND d.source_system NOT IN ('fl_dbpr', 'fl_dfs')
    ORDER BY disposition_date DESC NULLS LAST, entered_date DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 50
    ) detail_row) AS discipline,
current_timestamp AS checked_at;
unique_credential_query: SELECT DISTINCT c.slug FROM licenses l JOIN contractors c ON c.id = l.contractor_id WHERE l.source_system = 'fl_dbpr' AND l.external_key = 'CCC057187' AND c.slug IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3
ask_query: SELECT b.id AS binding_id, b.network_entity_id, b.hub, b.specialist_entity_type, b.identifier_namespace, b.source_identifier, b.jurisdiction, b.binding_status, b.valid_to, e.status AS network_entity_status, e.canonical_public_profile_ref FROM network.network_entity_bindings b JOIN network.network_entities e ON e.id=b.network_entity_id WHERE b.hub='contractor' AND b.identifier_namespace='fl.dbpr.license' AND b.source_identifier='CCC057187' AND b.valid_to IS NULL
